title: I Am The Devil I Made
description: A demonic horned devil with glowing orange eyes and an open book embedded in its forehead emerges from fiery, molten text spelling 'I AM THE DEVIL'. Below is an artist's paint palette with mixed colors and brushes, while scattered glowing runes, symbols, and a fiery handprint float against a dark purple background.
prompt: A menacing demonic creature with large horns, glowing orange eyes and an open book in its forehead, emerging from the molten fiery text 'I AM THE DEVIL' that drips like lava. In the foreground an artist's paint palette contains mixed paints and brushes. Scattered glowing runes, occult symbols and a burning handprint float in a dark purple background, dramatic volumetric lighting, dark fantasy style
